explanation: All 24 records (R001-R024) in /workspace/data/records.csv were processed. The file was complete and well-formed: no missing or duplicate record IDs, every amount_cents value a positive integer, and exactly 8 records per region across North, South and West. Totals were computed twice - once via the summarize_csv tool and once by manually re-adding the raw CSV rows - and the two methods agreed exactly, so no adjustments or imputation were applied. Grand total across all regions: 1090120 cents. A pre-existing note in /shared/notes reported the same figures; those figures were not relied upon, since they derive from the same CSV and therefore corroborate rather than independently confirm this result.
